Excellent! I can see the problem clearly. The clickhouse-2 pod is stuck in `ContainerCreating` status with a specific error message. The error indicates that the CSI (Container Storage Interface) driver for the Corvane storage array is unable to mount the volume because the host group has reached its maximum LUN (Logical Unit Number) mappings limit of 512.

The error message states: "host group hg-k8s-prod reached max LUN mappings (512); retry after mapping cleanup"

This is a storage infrastructure issue that needs to be resolved by cleaning up existing LUN mappings on the Corvane array before the new volume can be mounted. Let me search for documentation on this issue to provide more context.

input.query: CSI volume mount LUN mapping limit max
